stem.text: A dipole is a pair of charges of equal magnitude, one negative and one positive. The electric field of a dipole is shown below.
In which direction does the force act on an electron when at point X?

stem.alt: Electric field lines of a dipole: a grey oval with a minus sign on the left and a plus sign on the right; point X is marked above the oval, with arrows labelled A (leftwards), B and C (downwards) and D (rightwards) starting from X.
